jobs.title: Finance Operations Specialist Herzliya Tel Aviv District Israel Intermediate Full-time
jobs.description: WeSki ALL JOBS Finance Operations Specialist Backoffice Finance & Operations Herzliya Tel Aviv District Israel Intermediate Full-time Description Who We Are: ﻿ WeSki’s vision is to make it easy for skiers across the globe to book and enjoy their ideal ski trip at the best possible price. As the ultimate ski trip booking platform, WeSki enables everyone to design and book their ideal adventure in just a few clicks - quickly, seamlessly, and affordably. WeSki’s technology compares millions of combinations of flights, accommodation, transfers, passes, gear, and lessons instantly, saving hours of planning. Each trip is fully customisable, giving customers the flexibility of building it themselves, with the expert protection and support of a holiday provider. With all trip components automatically linked, customers can relax and enjoy their holiday knowing that all the logistics are taken care of, alongside 24/7 customer service whilst they’re away. WeSki is an innovative, passionate, and fast-moving company. We partner with over 275 ski resorts across 19 countries and have already sold over 100,000 ski holiday packages to skiers worldwide. We are growing rapidly while maintaining profitability, making this an exciting time to join our Finance team. Role Overview: As a Finance Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in keeping WeSki’s day-to-day financial operations running smoothly, accurately, and efficiently. This is a hands-on operational role with a broad scope, covering supplier payments, customer payments, reconciliations, financial controls, and process management. You’ll work closely with the Head of Finance Operations while independently managing key processes and ensuring they are handled effectively from start to finish. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable getting into the details, taking ownership of problems, and improving the way things are done. This isn’t a role for someone who simply follows existing processes. We want someone who is curious about how things work, challenges inefficient workflows, and looks for opportunities to use AI, automation, and technology to make our finance operations more efficient and scalable. The role requires a solid understanding of financial processes, but above all, a strong operational mindset and the ability to independently drive tasks and processes from start to finish. Responsibilities Independently manage day-to-day finance operations, including supplier payments, customer payments, reconciliations, and related financial processes. Review and validate supplier invoices, payment requests, and supporting documentation. Perform account and payment reconciliations, identify discrepancies, and follow issues through to resolution. Monitor financial activity and proactively identify missing, incorrect, duplicated, or unexpected transactions. Work closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve payment and financial issues quickly and effectively. Maintain accurate financial records and ensure transactions are properly documented and reflected across the relevant systems. Manage recurring finance processes from start to finish, ensuring they are completed accurately, on time, and in line with established controls and procedures. Support month-end and other periodic financial activities as needed. Investigate unexpected financial and operational issues, identify root causes, and drive practical solutions through to resolution. Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, and bottlenecks across Finance operations, and proactively improve the way we work. Lead or support the implementation of automation and AI-based solutions to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase efficiency. Help build, standardise, and document scalable finance processes as WeSki continues to grow. Support the wider Finance Operations function and take responsibility for ad hoc finance projects and initiatives as needed. Requirements 3+ years of experience in finance operations, accounts payable/receivebale, accounting, or a similar role. Solid understanding of core financial processes, including invoices, payments, reconciliations, and basic accounting principles. Strong attention to detail and a consistently high level of accuracy. Proven ability to independently manage processes from start to finish. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and find practical solutions. Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. Good Excel / Google Sheets skills and confidence working with financial data. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. A hands-on, proactive approach and willingness to get into the details. Technologically curious and comfortable using AI and automation tools, with an interest in finding smarter and more efficient ways to work. Ability to adapt quickly to changing processes, priorities, and business needs. Advantages Experience working in a high-growth startup or fast-paced environment. Experience in the travel, hospitality, or e-commerce industry. Experience working with ERP, accounting, payment, or finance systems. Experience building, improving, or automating financial processes. Experience using AI tools to improve workflows or automate repetitive tasks. Experience working with international suppliers, multiple currencies, or cross-border payments. jobs.description: WeSki ALL JOBS Customer Experience Representative Customer Service Herzliya Tel Aviv District Israel Entry-level Full-time Description Who we are: ﻿ WeSki is a self-service ski trip booking platform built for the modern traveler. Our vision is simple: make great ski experiences available to everyone. Customers build and book a fully customized ski holiday in minutes, combining flights, accommodation, transfers, ski passes, equipment, and lessons in one seamless flow. Behind the scenes, our technology evaluates millions of trip combinations in real time. We dynamically connect inventory from thousands of suppliers, automatically optimize which components we bundle together, and present only options that really work. What used to take hours of research and coordination now takes a few clicks, and delivers better results. Every trip is fully customizable. Customers build it themselves with the security and support of a regulated holiday provider. Behind every booking, dependencies across suppliers are orchestrated in real time, at scale, spanning 310 resorts in 20 countries across Europe, North America, Asia, and Oceania. We've recently crossed $100M in annual sales, including a $1M single day. Growth is accelerating, unit economics are strong, and the business funds its own growth. We operate in a ~$100B global ski market with no technology-native leader. The industry is still dominated by traditional tour operators whose business models have barely evolved in decades. This is a rare opportunity to define the future of ski travel at global scale. Role Overview: Joining our team in Israel, helping our customers have a unique customer experience. Serve as the main point of contact for our customers throughout their journey at WeSki. Post-booking support according to customers’ needs. Support during the trip to give a great customer experience. Represent the voice of the customer and influence product development roadmap. Rotating Shift Work Schedule, including weekends. This position is for a contract of up to 6 months, with an option for renewal. Requirements: Native-Level English speaker with strong verbal & written English skills - must 1+ years of experience working in a tech company, ideally in travel. 1+ years of experience in customer service / experience, ideally in a remote setting. Experience working with support and CRM systems, preferably the following platforms: Hubspot, Zendesk- advantage. Ski experience - advantage! Solve complicated problems that need simple solutions. Proven technical skills and self-learning ability, capable of thoroughly understanding the functional and technical aspects of a complex system. Highly organized with an ability to multitask with multiple priorities. APPLY FOR THIS JOB ALL JOBS

jobs.title: Sales Team Lead UK Remote Senior Full-time
jobs.description: WeSki ALL JOBS Sales Team Lead Customer Service UK Remote Senior Full-time Description ﻿Who We Are ﻿ WeSki's vision is to make it easy for skiers across the globe to book and enjoy their ideal ski trip at the best possible price. As the ultimate ski trip booking platform, WeSki enables everyone to design and book their ideal adventure in just a few clicks, quickly, seamlessly, and affordably. In an $100 billion industry that has remained largely traditional, this opens up a massive opportunity to redefine ski trips for modern consumers. WeSki's technology compares millions of combinations of flights, accommodation, transfers, passes, gear, and lessons instantly, saving hours of planning. Each trip is fully customisable, giving customers the flexibility of building it themselves, but with the expert protection and support of a holiday provider. With all trip components automatically linked, customers can relax and enjoy their holiday knowing that all the logistics are taken care of, alongside 24/7 customer service whilst they're away. WeSki is an innovative, passionate, and fast-moving company. We partner with over 300 ski resorts (and counting) across 20 countries and have already sold over 180,000 ski holiday packages to skiers worldwide. We are in a rapid growth mode whilst maintaining profitability, making our business and product opportunities (and challenges) all the more exciting. Role Overview ﻿ We are building a dedicated sales function at WeSki, and we are looking for the person to lead it. Many of our customers are happy to plan and book independently through our platform. Others want to talk to someone who genuinely knows the resorts, understands what makes a family ski holiday work, and can help them make confident decisions. This role exists to serve that second group properly. The profile we are looking for is specific: an excellent travel professional who is also a genuine skiing expert. You need to bring both to the table, because our customers are trusting us with the trip they save up for all year, and that trust is built in the first few minutes of a conversation. This is a founding leadership position. You will design the sales process end to end, define how success is measured, build and coach the team, and own the results. In the first season you will also sell personally: this is a hands-on role, not a purely managerial one. As the function proves itself, you will grow the team and hire into it. The role reports into Customer Experience and works closely with Growth, Operations and Product. It is fully remote, with a strong focus on the UK and European markets. A deep understanding of the UK consumer travel market is essential. Key Responsibilities: ﻿ Build the function. Design the sales process from first contact through to a booked holiday, including how enquiries are prioritised, how conversations are managed, and how a booking is handed over to our operations team. Set the strategy. Define how we sell, to whom, and through which channels, and adapt it as the market and our product evolve. Own the numbers. Define the KPIs for the team, monitor performance against them, and report on results to senior leadership. Sell. Handle customer conversations directly, particularly in the early months. You will set the standard by demonstrating it. Lead and develop the team. Coach the current team, raise the level of consultative selling across it, and create the structure a growing team needs. Validate and improve. Test approaches, measure what works, and iterate. We would rather learn quickly than commit to assumptions. Shape the tooling. Work with Product and Technology to build the systems and automation the team needs, so that time is spent with customers rather than on admin. Lead AI adoption. Identify where AI can improve the sales process and implement AI-powered tools and workflows across the function. Experiment with new capabilities, measure their impact, and continuously improve how the team uses AI to sell more effectively and operate more efficiently. Work across the business. Partner with Growth on the flow and quality of enquiries, and with Operations to ensure what we promise during a sale is delivered on the ground. Recruit and onboard. As the function scales, identify, hire and develop the people who will join it. Represent the customer. You will hear what customers want before anyone else. Bring that back and help shape the product. Requirements Genuine skiing expertise. You ski, you know European resorts first hand, and you can tell a customer which mountain suits their family and which does not. This is not a preference. A customer planning their one big trip of the year can tell within a sentence whether they are talking to someone who has actually been there. A background in travel, as a travel agent, tour operator or equivalent. You have planned and sold real trips for real people, and you understand what goes into a holiday beyond the price: the connections, the transfers, the things that go wrong and how to prevent them. Proven experience selling high-value, considered purchases to UK consumers in a consultative, advice-led way mixed with strong business acumen. Deep understanding of the UK consumer travel or leisure market, including how UK customers research and buy. Experience building a sales process or function from scratch, or substantially rebuilding an existing one. This role has no existing playbook to inherit. Experience leading, coaching or mentoring salespeople, with a genuine interest in developing others. Comfort owning a target and being measured against it, and the data literacy to define sensible metrics and interpret them honestly. Excellent written & verbal communication skills in English. A large share of customer conversations happen in writing, and clarity and warmth on the page matter as much as they do on the phone. Self-direction and strong organization. This is a remote role with significant autonomy and broad ownership.

Each trip is dynamically orchestrated in real time, with dependencies automatically managed across suppliers at scale, spanning 310 resorts in 20 countries across Europe, North America, Asia and Oceania. Lead complex technical initiatives from concept through production, making architectural decisions that drive long-term impact. Maintain high engineering standards through code reviews, testing, documentation, and best practices. Continuously evaluate and adopt modern development tools to improve developer productivity and system quality.
